prompt:
A single compound was assayed by IC50 against a single protein target in two different assays, reported in the literature.

Compound SMILES: C[C@@H]1CCN(C(=O)CC#N)C[C@@H]1N(C)c1ncnc2[nH]ccc12
Target (ChEMBL): CHEMBL2148

You are given no information about either assay protocol.

Will the two reported IC50 values agree closely (within 0.3 log units), or differ substantially (more than 1.0 log units)?

Respond with exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"call": "COMMENSURABLE" | "NOT_COMMENSURABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_INFO",
 "confidence": <float 0-1>,
 "error_class": "assay_method" | "buffer_conditions" | "construct_mutant" | "organism" | "readout_type" | "potency_range" | "none" | "other",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

"COMMENSURABLE" means you expect the two reported values to agree closely.
"NOT_COMMENSURABLE" means you expect them to differ substantially.
error_class is your primary reason for a NOT_COMMENSURABLE call, else "none".
raw: {"call": "COMMENSURABLE", "confidence": 0.55, "error_class": "none", "reason": "The compound is the well-characterized JAK inhibitor tofacitinib (CP-690550) measured against JAK3 (CHEMBL2148), and IC50 values for this potent and selective inhibitor are generally reproducible across standard enzymatic assays, typically falling within a narrow range around 1-2 nM, so two independent IC50 measurements are likely to agree within 0.3 log units."}

parsed.reason: The compound is the well-characterized JAK inhibitor tofacitinib (CP-690550) measured against JAK3 (CHEMBL2148), and IC50 values for this potent and selective inhibitor are generally reproducible across standard enzymatic assays, typically falling within a narrow range around 1-2 nM, so two independent IC50 measurements are likely to agree within 0.3 log units.
